description: This source file defines the NoteReadonlyFragment class, a subclass of NotePreviewFragment, used to display a read-only view of a note in the Android client for Nextcloud Notes. It primarily disables editing and hides various menu options, indicating its role as a read-only interface.

classes.name: NoteReadonlyFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a note in a read-only mode, disabling editing capabilities and hiding user interface controls related to editing, sharing, or deleting notes.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Overrides menu preparation to hide various menu items that allow editing or managing the note.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment view and disables content editing and swipe refresh layout.

methods.name: registerInternalNoteLinkHandler
methods.description: Overridden to do nothing; disables internal note link handling.

methods.name: showEditTitleDialog
methods.description: Overridden to do nothing; disables showing the edit title dialog.

methods.name: onCloseNote
methods.description: Overridden to do nothing; disables closing the note.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Overridden to do nothing; disables saving the note.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of NoteReadonlyFragment with the provided note content as an argument.
